description.zh: 恭喜！你正式成为宇宙的一部分了。从物理学角度来看，这是一项伟大的成就。遗憾的是，你的旅行保险并不承认这种存在形式。
description.en: Congratulations! You are now part of the universe in the most literal sense. Physicists call it a great achievement. Your travel insurance, unfortunately, calls it an exclusion.

description.zh: 你已经无法区分巧合与奇迹。好消息是，宇宙似乎也不能。毕竟，快乐才是宇宙的真理。
description.en: You can no longer tell coincidence from miracle. Fortunately, neither can the universe. After all, happiness is the ultimate truth of the cosmos.

description.zh: 超新星没能杀死你，黑洞也没能杀死你。你将在无限的时间里向着死亡坍缩。
description.en: Neither a supernova nor a black hole could kill you. Now, with all eternity ahead, you slowly collapse towards death itself.

description.zh: 你的脸出现在数千颗星球的广告牌上，所有物种和星体都对着你尖叫。不过传播的主要是一张你吃饭时被拍到的糊照。
description.en: Your face appears on billboards across thousands of planets. Every species—and even the stars themselves—screams at the sight of you. Unfortunately, the image going viral is a blurry photo of you eating lunch.

description.zh: 你随口说出“香蕉才是宇宙的答案”，三亿信徒立即宣布成立新宗教。你打算解释这只是个玩笑，但教会认为这正是神谕的一部分。
description.en: You casually declare that bananas are the answer to the universe. Three hundred million followers establish a religion. When you explain it was a joke, they call your denial the second prophecy.

description.zh: 你写出了足以解释宇宙万物的统一理论。遗憾的是，论文足足有四万七千页，还没有任何期刊的投稿系统支持这么大的文件。
description.en: You formulate a theory that explains everything in the universe. Unfortunately, the manuscript is forty-seven thousand pages long, and no academic submission portal accepts the attachment.

description.zh: 你连续中了七次星际大奖，赌场已经把你的照片挂在门口，旁边写着“谢绝入内”。你说这只是一点运气，统计学界认为这是一种挑衅。
description.en: You win seven galactic jackpots in a row. Casinos post your face beside NO ENTRY signs. You call it a little luck. Statisticians call it a personal attack.

description.zh: 你以近乎失效的生命体征完成了全部旅程。医生称这不算医学奇迹，而算一次行政管理失误。总之，活下来就是胜利。
description.en: You complete the journey with vital signs that are barely on speaking terms. Your doctor calls it less a medical miracle and more an administrative oversight. Still, survival is survival.

description.zh: 你踏足了许多星球，没有人记得你来过。连自动监控都礼貌地跳过你的身影。你倒是乐得清静，毕竟没有人能向你推销保险。
description.en: You visit dozens of worlds without anyone remembering you. Even security cameras politely overlook your presence. At least no salesperson can offer you interplanetary insurance.

description.zh: 你已经停止尝试理解宇宙。奇怪的是，当你不再思考，一切似乎都顺利多了。但是星际哲学协会对此深表不安。
description.en: You stop trying to understand the universe. Things immediately become easier. But the Interstellar Philosophy Association finds this development deeply upsetting.

description.zh: 你同时被陨石、鸟粪和自动售货机砸中，保险公司一致拒绝签约。你的倒霉程度已被学术界列为一种可以独立观察的自然现象。
description.en: You are struck by a meteorite, an alien bird dropping and a vending machine in the same week. Insurers refuse coverage. Scientists begin classifying your misfortune as a natural phenomenon.

description.zh: 你成功走过了七天，没有成神，没有出名，也没有被拉成意大利面。也许平凡的生活才是真正的幸福。
description.en: You make it through seven days without becoming a god, a celebrity, or a strand of cosmic spaghetti. Perhaps an ordinary life really is the greatest happiness of all.
